content.short: Mushroom Mob is a collection of pixelated mushrooms on a mission to improve our health & wellbeing and protect our planet.
content.description:
Mushroom Mob is a collection of pixelated mushrooms. There are 10 core mushrooms and over 100 different traits, giving over a billion possible combinations!

Our project focuses on health and looking after our planet. Join our community wellbeing challenges that reward you for investing in your health and wellbeing. 15% of our earnings will be donated to fungi conservation and psychedelic research to improve mental health care. Mushroom Mob holders also get free access to online health and wellbeing workshops run by registered and qualified health professionals.

Minting now for 25 ADA each (discount for buying more than 5)
